scope: Offline asset explorer Core implementation and format research for v0.7. Existing v0.6 packages and files were not modified.
status: Core complete; 105 synthetic checks plus 108 private retail checks pass. Root owns WPF integration and final release verification.
addresses: Native VAs at image base0x140000000; no synthetic CIL addresses or native-call claims.

Functions.Finding: BAR type lookup reads count at +4, traverses 16-byte entries from +16, compares a UInt16 type and returns the requested matching entry.
Functions.Limitations: No file bounds or signature validation is provided by this native search helper.

Functions.Finding: BAR lookup additionally compares the exact four-byte tag at entry+4 and supports repeated matching entries.
Functions.Limitations: A duplicate tag/type is legal; the browser must preserve ordinal and occurrence.

Functions.Finding: Counts entries by optional type and exact DWORD tag using the same 16-byte layout.
Counts entries matching a UInt16 type, with -1 selecting any type.

Initial relocation converts disk-relative entry offsets into packed pointers and records the runtime base at header+8. Empty entries become null. Types1/17/20/30/46 recurse; entry+2 bit0 suppresses type-specific fixups.
Functions.Limitations: Offline parsing must use unrelocated file data, not this mutating engine helper. Exact semantics of other entry+2 bits are unproved.

Functions.Finding: Relocating an already-loaded BAR adjusts entries by the difference between old decoded base and new container base, then runs selected type-specific relocators.
Functions.Limitations: This is runtime relocation, not a second disk format.

Functions.Finding: Traverses already-relocated entry pointers and recursively resets selected nested/model/motion/audio resources, respecting entry+2 bit0.
Functions.Limitations: Does not justify executing any engine constructor in an offline explorer.

Functions.Finding: Developer exporter checks the first three BAR magic bytes and locates each nonempty payload as container plus UInt32 entry offset. Five nested types recur.
Functions.Limitations: Unsafe developer path-writing behavior was only inspected. This routine was never executed.

Functions.Finding: Converter declares header layout4c/3i and entry layout1s/1s/1i/1i/1i; type dispatch distinguishes models, textures, motions, TIM2, events and nested containers. Type2 interpretation depends on path.
Functions.Limitations: Type labels are not full payload validation or a promise of decoding/rendering.

Functions.Finding: Opens matching HED/PKG files; HED count is file length divided by32.
Functions.Limitations: Offline implementation must add exact-divisibility, size and span checks omitted by the game.

Functions.Finding: Hashes a relative resource path with MD5, scans32-byte HED records, seeks the stored64-bit offset, reads header16 and remaster records48. It overwrites remaster physical offsets by walking stored lengths.
Functions.Limitations: HED hash identifies a filename, not content integrity. Disk remaster offset fields must not be trusted as physical package offsets.

Functions.Finding: Base payload starts after header16 plus48*remasterCount. For raw length>16 and enabled package mode, positive stored length transforms then inflates; -1 transforms without inflation; raw path otherwise reads decoded length.
Functions.Limitations: Small payload bypass and the object+292 mode gate differ from a generic compressed-file decoder; only observed retail modes are proposed.

Functions.Finding: Remaster reader uses the recomputed metadata+32 physical offset, raw length+40 and mode+44; raw length>16 permits transform/inflate. No object+292 gate is used here.
Functions.Limitations: This round validated remaster metadata spans, not decoded remaster contents.

Functions.Finding: Copies the16-byte package header, replaces zero seed bytes with their indexes, derives round keys, and transforms complete16-byte blocks only up to256 bytes.
Functions.Limitations: A native global can disable transformation. The offline proposal does not reproduce runtime globals; it supports verified retail disk data.

Functions.Finding: Key object receives16 seed bytes, key-word count4, round count10, and initializes its key schedule.
Functions.Limitations: Fixed package invocation only; broader key lengths are not required by the proposed reader.

Functions.Finding: Block transform XORs all11 derived round keys into a16-byte block without AES substitution/mix rounds.
Functions.Limitations: This is an XOR transform using an AES-shaped key schedule, not standard AES decryption.

Functions.Finding: Expands the supplied key with byte rotation/substitution and round constants into the round-key buffer.
Functions.Limitations: The supporting substitution helper/table was separately inspected, but complete new evidence for that tiny helper is not included here.

limitations: Structural BAR validation and descriptive type labels do not fully decode models, textures, scripts or audio.
Retail payload comparisons are selected real fixtures, not exhaustive decompression of every record.
Version1 disk BARs with unrelocated base0 and observed package modes -2/-1/positive are supported; unknown modes fail explicitly.
Package payloads decode into a bounded memory buffer before exposure; prefix preview of a package still validates the selected complete payload.
No source writes, package rebuilding, script execution, process hooks or native game function calls occur in the Core.
Identity and metadata guards prevent stale locators; raw payload bytes are not cryptographically authenticated against an adversary who can rewrite content and restore metadata.
UI render checks and final package integration are owned by Root; this subagent performed no UI/live action.

notes: Real assets were read from the local installation; they are not bundled as fixtures.
Raw remaster comparisons validate logical bytes and permitted loose alignment padding separately.

implementation_facts: Signed negative counts/lengths, overflow and out-of-source spans are rejected before allocations and extraction.
BAR children carry exact parent metadata digests; HED and package metadata are revalidated before decoding.
Windows volume/file ID, creation/write times and size are captured and checked under read-only source handles.
Export keeps existing directories open against replacement, creates a new temporary file, and atomically moves without overwrite.
Destination checks reject Windows aliases, device/ADS names, reparse paths, protected folders and source game root.
Zlib decoder enforces exact output length, verified Adler checksum and at most15 padding bytes; cancellation reaches reads, inflate and checksum work.
Opaque immutable descriptors and bounded owning streams preserve lifetime across nested containers.
